title: Sensitivity conjecture
statement: Every Boolean function f on {0,1}^n has sensitivity at least sqrt(degree f).
how_it_was_proved: Huang showed that every induced subgraph of the n-cube on more than half the vertices has a vertex of degree at least sqrt(n), by a signed adjacency matrix whose square is n times the identity and Cauchy interlacing; the reduction of Gotsman and Linial then gives the conjecture.

formal.theorem: Sensitivity.huang_degree_theorem (the degree theorem; the Gotsman-Linial reduction is not formalized there)

sources.cite: H. Huang, Induced subgraphs of hypercubes and a proof of the Sensitivity Conjecture, Ann. of Math. 190 (2019) 949-955

steps.statement: A signed adjacency matrix A_n of the n-cube with A_n^2 = n I
An induced subgraph on 2^(n-1)+1 vertices has maximum degree at least sqrt(n)
steps.how: Cauchy interlacing transports the eigenvalue sqrt(n)
